description.value:
This elegant mask features a multicolored diamond pattern and lace edging. Used among spies, jesters, and serving staff to pass along secret messages, these masks often come with a mundane copy that can be switched without drawing attention. You gain a +1 item bonus to Deception checks while wearing the mask.

Activate—Message Received 1 (concentrate, mental)

Requirements There is information stored in the mask

Effect You instantly receive the information stored in the mask.

Activate—Store Gossip 2 (concentrate, mental)

Effect You mentally store an amount of information that could be verbally communicated in 10 minutes inside the mask, or you erase its current contents. The information remains in the mask until Store Gossip is used again.
